handling_semantics.block: The failure must stop publish/apply until the structured contract is corrected.
handling_semantics.replayable: The failure is mechanically repairable through deterministic derive plus bounded replay/apply.
handling_semantics.manual: The failure requires human confirmation or authoring and must remain explicit instead of being guessed.
handling_semantics.reconciliation: Live state and source-log contract conflict, so automation must stop and surface the mismatch instead of overwriting either side blindly.

families.name: strong-structure
families.description: Deterministic contract surfaces whose expected values can be derived mechanically from source logs or canonical specs.

families.name: weak-structure
families.description: Bounded prose or human-authored surfaces that may drift without invalidating the entire publish/apply pipeline.

surfaces.reason: Expected PR labels are derived deterministically from issue_top_labels, issue_scope_labels, issue_module_labels, explicit pr_labels, and drills/evidence eligibility.

surfaces.owner_surface: source-log issue link or explicit pr_development_issue
surfaces.reason: The expected Development issue is deterministic, and GitHub-recognized linkage now depends on explicit trailing close-link rows such as Closes #309.

surfaces.owner_surface: source-log parent spine linkage + live GitHub relationship state
surfaces.reason: GitHub sidebar relationships are separate from body metadata and require explicit relationship apply rather than prose edits.
When the source log owns explicit issue/pr linkage, blank or stale write-back breaks later deterministic derive and historical replay.
Missing or misplaced canonical sections break contract validation and should stop publish/apply rather than be silently tolerated.
recent_examples: historical S0E PR family audited by S0E-4F/P2
closed child-issue refresh batches under S0E-6F

surfaces.reason: Final issue conclusion DoD must preserve exact merged PR refs, so drift is mechanically repairable from merged PR evidence.

surfaces.owner_surface: source-log intent versus live GitHub state
surfaces.reason: When both sides are explicit but disagree, automation must stop and surface the mismatch instead of replaying one side over the other.
recent_examples: issue number/url mismatch in backfill planning
source-log issue URL conflicts with explicit issue reference

surfaces.owner_surface: human-authored or single-item generated Context prose
surfaces.reason: Context wording is bounded by gate rules but still requires human-quality judgment and should not be guessed by batch replay once ownership is single-item authoring.

surfaces.owner_surface: human-facing summary bullets or prose blocks
surfaces.reason: Summary wording should remain compact and deterministic, but wording quality itself is not a mechanical contract breach unless it leaks placeholders into publish surfaces.
recent_examples: PR Summary placeholder follow-up under S0E-4C
natural-language issue Context drift under S0E-6D

surfaces.surface: operator notes outside canonical source blocks
surfaces.reason: Freeform notes may inform later work, but they must not be mistaken for deterministic source rows consumed by automation.
recent_examples: S0E-4C Evidence Footer Source note drift
